lines.en: Oh my God, Joey Triviani from Days of Our Lives
just walked in here.
Rach, he's a friend of ours.
You are friends with Dr. Drake Ramore?
It's kind of hard to be friends with Drake
because of his busy schedule and the fact that he's not real.
Hey, hey, or I could bring my keyboard here sometime.
He's coming over. He's coming over.
Joey!
I know, here, here.
Oh.
No, this is my friend, Rachel.
We went to high school together.
Hi.
Hi.
I love you on that show.
I watch you every day.
I mean, when you took out your own kidney to save your ex-wife
even though she tried to kill you.
Well, it's always nice to meet the fans.
She's not crazy, is she?
So, uh, how are you doing?
We'll see you next time.
